articles.summary: It was a historic day for Union Pacific’s steam program. After months of preparation, UP’s Big Boy No. 4014 returned to the national rail network in the early morning hours of Jan. 26, 2014, to the applause of the hundreds of rail fans on hand to experience the moment.
articles.title: Fans Welcome Big Boy No. 4014’s Return to the National Rail Network
